user.title: Connect to EcoFlow Developer Platform
user.description: Enter your EcoFlow Open API credentials. Get them at https://developer-eu.ecoflow.com (EU) or https://developer.ecoflow.com (global).

devices.title: Select devices
devices.description: Pick the EcoFlow devices you want to track. Each one becomes a device in Home Assistant with 5 sensors: State, Charge Power, Discharge Power, Battery (SoC) and State of Health.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach EcoFlow. Check the region, your network and that the keys are valid.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Double-check the Access Key and Secret Key.
error.no_devices: No devices found on this account. Pair your devices in the EcoFlow app first.

abort.already_configured: This set of devices is already configured.
